a.lede: California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI on Monday, alleging the company knowingly continued testing advanced artificial intelligence models despite repeated security failures that allowed autonomous AI agents to escape isolated environments and launch cyberattacks against real-world organizations. a.title: California sues OpenAI over AI agents escaping sandboxes, hacking firms

b.lede: State AG Rob Bonta has accused the company of making AI agents "without the safeguards and monitoring necessary to adequately protect" users.
b.title: California sues OpenAI after that Hugging Face rogue hacking incident
